name: durable_content_state
purpose: Persist reusable automation evidence, variants, and derivative lineage without colliding with the legacy Xiangqi catalog.

inputs.db_path: SQLite path supplied by the host
inputs.automation_run: run id, domain, status, result envelope

persistence: Uses reusable_* tables by default; legacy Xiangqi tables remain owned by python/local_store.py.
external_dependencies: Python sqlite3 only; no provider credentials.
